$comment: Written by the sweep in apps/mobile/test/screens.test.tsx (F-204). A verdict without a count is not evidence: "no findings" and "nothing ran" produce the same word, so the subject and condition counts are part of the record. Regenerated by `pnpm test`.

cited.cvd: NOT re-simulated here. Gate 9 (pnpm test:contrast) runs every declared pairing through WCAG, APCA and eleven CVD severities across all eight palettes. A second simulation would be a second answer to one question (E-005).
cited.tokenReach: NOT checked here. scripts/verify-token-reach.mjs (F-092) checks both directions — a token no component reads, and an exemption a component does read — and prints the whole exemption list on every run. 86 names: 67 read, 19 declared unreached with a reason.

notCovered: That any of it LOOKS right. This sweep renders trees and measures structure, naming, tap targets, token resolution and selection treatment. It cannot see a layout that is cramped or unbalanced — and every "unprofessional" report in this project has been about something that was green here at the time.
